articles.title: Visions of AI: An Inflection Point in Robotaxis in 2027
articles.content:
早上好，

希望你度过了愉快的夏天。我喜欢思考人工智能领域的宏观趋势，让你更清楚地了解变化的速度和方向。规模化自动驾驶汽车上路的进展滞后了大约十年，但现在有迹象表明，无人出租车（Robotaxi）的发展即将进入加速阶段，而领头羊是Alphabet旗下的Waymo。

这让特斯拉和优步感到紧张。优步本周裁减了3,000多名员工，意味着它需要更快转向无人出租车业务以应对即将到来的挑战。关键信号出现在今年2月，当时Waymo融资了惊人的160亿美元。

现在9月，事态发展迅速，Waymo计划在丹佛、圣迭戈和坦帕推进无人出租车扩张。基于现有数据，我预测2027年及整个2020年代末将成为无人出租车规模化的“转折点”。这不仅是Waymo的努力，整个行业包括多家美国和中国企业都在参与。这场变革正在全球范围内快速展开。

据《彭博社》报道，Alphabet的Waymo正处于首次债务融资的最后阶段，计划从包括太平洋投资管理公司（PIMCO）和黑石集团在内的贷款方筹集超过30亿美元。这种规模的资本、成熟度和执行力是优步、特斯拉等其他无人出租车竞争对手无法匹敌的。这意味着Waymo仅在2026年就融资近200亿美元，而且还没有结束。

在机器人领域被炒作但缺乏实际需求、太空经济由充满承诺的NASA推动、美国数据中心和制造业因贸易关税政策被强势推进的背景下，美国无人出租车的出现略显隐蔽。但实际上，这是一件大事。
articles.summary:
Good Morning,

I hope you have enjoyed your summer. I like to think about large macro trends in the AI space to give you a better idea about how fast things are moving and in what direction. Autonomous vehicles at scale on our roads came late, about a decade late but there are some promising signs that the robotaxi dream is about to accelerate in a meaningful way. It’s being led by Alphabet spin-out Waymo.

It’s getting Tesla and Uber really nervous. The Uber layoffs of over 3,000 employees this week means it needs to pivot back harder into its Robotaxi to face the coming storm. The key signal occurred earlier this year in February when Waymo raised an astounding $16 Billion.

Now in September things are moving fast, Waymo plans to accelerate robotaxi expansion with launches in Denver, San Diego, and Tampa. I have enough data to predict that 2027 and the late 2020s broadly speaking will be an “inflection point” for Robotaxi scaling. This isn’t just occurring with Waymo but the entire ecosystem with several U.S. and Chinese players. It’s happening globally and at scale.

Share

This week according to Bloomberg we have learned that Alphabet's Waymo is in the final stages of talks to raise debt for the first ​time, seeking more than $3 billion from lenders ‌including Pacific Investment Management and Blackstone. This is the kind of capital, maturity and execution that cannot be beaten by the likes of Uber, Tesla or other Robotaxi competitors. This means Waymo raised nearly $20 Billion in 2026 alone, and it’s not even done yet.

At a time when robotics is being hyped but lacks real world demand, the space economy is being built by a NASA with big promises, and U.S. datacenters and manufacturing is being pushed (even on other parts of the world and with trade tariff diplomacy) - the advent of the American robotaxi is being a little, overshadowed. But it’s actually a big deal.
